name: Being Ashamed Of God
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that openly confessing Christ before others is essential, as Jesus promises to acknowledge such believers before the Father (Matthew 10:32). Conversely, being ashamed of Christ and His words in a sinful generation results in the Son of Man being ashamed of that person when He returns in glory (Mark 8:38; Luke 9:26). True discipleship requires obedience to Christ’s commands, not merely verbal profession (Luke 6:46). The apostle Paul exemplifies this boldness, declaring he is not ashamed of the gospel because it is the power of God for salvation to all who believe (Romans 1:16).
